paper.title: Decentralised convex optimisation with probability-proportional-to-size quantization

algorithm.name: Local component only: Lemma 3 barycenter stochastic gradient and Eq. (1) PPS quantization (not Algorithm 3 verification)
citations: PDF p. 20, Lemma 3, sample conjugate-gradient softmax
PDF p. 19, Section 6.1 and Eq. (9), continuous source probabilities and continuous transport cost
PDF pp. 6-7, Section 2, minibatch definition and PPS Eq. (1)
PDF p. 7, paragraph after Eq. (1), interpretation of fixed uniform random arguments
assumptions: Each source law is a bounded continuous uniform probability measure; all supplied samples lie strictly within its support.
The selected squared-distance cost is continuous and nonnegative; gamma is positive. Every sample and batch gradient lies in the simplex with l1 bound B=1.
All local arguments are public, nonzero vectors freely chosen from the unconstrained domain of the Lemma 3 conjugate. They are not derived from a repository run or an Algorithm 3 trajectory.

PPS takes the average unquantized sample gradient and then uses the fixed uniform arguments. The probability vector has no negative part, so no arbitrary negative categorical distribution is introduced.

A pass establishes only the listed local operators at these finite inputs. It cannot establish graph communication, accelerated updates, primal restoration, global coordinate scaling, or full Algorithm 3 correctness.

cases.purpose: Check the signed local argument, non-unit gamma, per-sample softmax normalization, averaging before quantization, and fixed-uniform PPS in two distinct bounded draws.

parameters.local_oracle: At each listed call independently, evaluate p_h=exp((mu_h-c(y_h,xi))/gamma)/sum_l exp((mu_l-c(y_l,xi))/gamma) for every source sample, then average the r vectors before PPS.
parameters.pps_rule: Apply Eq. (1) to the minibatch mean. Positive mass is 1; negative mass is 0 and its term is absent. Each uniform chooses the first one-based h with u<cumulative_mean_probability[h]; quantized_gradient[h]=count(h)/M.
parameters.step_semantics: step 1 and step 2 are two separately specified oracle calls at the supplied nonzero local mu vectors. There is no recurrence between calls.
parameters.observation_semantics: sample_probabilities has source-sample rows and support columns; minibatch_mean and quantized_gradient have one component per support point; positive_mass is the l1 mass of the nonnegative batch gradient; pps_indices are one-based categories in public uniform order.
parameters.scope: Local Lemma 3 oracle and Eq. (1) PPS only. This contract does not test Algorithm 3 graph communication, accelerated dual updates, primal recovery, any global m-rescaling, or full algorithm correctness.

cases.purpose: Three support coordinates and three unequal source samples distinguish cost-adjusted softmax from linear normalization and distinguish quantizing a minibatch mean from independently quantizing sample gradients.
